cues: In a progressive wave, every particle vibrates with the same amplitude and the same frequency.
But each one starts its vibration slightly later than the one before it.
The phase lags steadily along the direction of travel.
text: Two more facts to remember. In a progressive wave, every particle vibrates with the same amplitude and the same frequency. But each one starts its vibration slightly later than the one before it. The phase lags steadily along the direction of travel.
